name: Ladybird
description:
Ladybird is a truly independent, open-source web browser and rendering engine written from scratch in modern C++. Founded to break the browser engine duopoly, Ladybird implements web standards without relying on Chromium, WebKit, or Gecko.

Features:
- Completely independent rendering and JavaScript engine (LibWeb and LibJS)
- Multi-process security model isolating tabs and web content into separate processes
- Built-in ad blocking and privacy protection without third-party tracking extensions
- Adheres directly to modern W3C and WHATWG web specifications
- Free and open-source software funded exclusively by non-profit community donations
